title: Idle Hands
controls_hint: Tap a cabinet drawer to begin
about: A touch-first cabinet of 60 replayable games for phone, tablet, and desktop, from Solitaire and Sudoku to Riddle Room, Pattern Vault, Sum Circuit, Orbit Order, and Word Forge.
Every drawer includes visible touch controls, a replayable tutorial, autosave, and personal records.

controls.desc: Choose cabinet objects, controls, cards, cells, dice, and discs
Move cards, mark puzzle cells, and slide tiles
Provide an alternative to every gesture
